senses.gloss: In addition; besides; as well; further; too.
Likewise.
name of the letter D, d
A merganser, Mergus merganser, of the northern hemisphere, that consume fish and are common on lakes and rivers.
A flag consisting of three stripes that are either vertical or horizontal, all of equal size, and each of a different colour.
A bed with a tough plastic mattress filled with water.
Rule by the people, especially as a form of government; either directly or through elected representatives (representative democracy).
Telling fortunes from the lines on the palms of the hand.
A small boat propelled by pedals that directly turn external paddles, used for recreation.
A midterm school exam (i.e., halfway through the term).
A question to be answered, schoolwork exercise.
A worded or expressed sentence, phrase, or only a word on its own, which asks for information, a reply, or a response; an interrogative.
(rare) A question; an interrogation.

A peninsula in West Asia, comprising most of the modern Republic of Turkey. Bounded by the Black Sea to the north, the Armenian Highland to the east, the Mediterranean Sea to the south and the Aegean Sea to the west.
A performance of a show or other broadcast on radio or television.
The communication of information to the general public etc.
A transmission of a radio or television programme intended to be received by anyone with a receiver.
The business or profession of radio and television.
Any fish of the order Siluriformes, mainly found in fresh water, lacking scales, and having barbels like whiskers around the mouth.
Having a name.
The right to vote at a public election or referendum; see: suffrage.
the right to vote
An instance of this chemical reaction, especially when intentionally created and maintained in a specific location to a useful end (such as a campfire or a hearth fire).
An elevated body temperature, as present in many illnesses; fever.
A higher than normal body temperature of a person (or, generally, a mammal), usually caused by disease.
(chiefly, military) The use of gunpowder-type weapons, mainly cannon, as opposed to swords or bayonets.
(figuratively) Something that acts or spreads quickly and uncontrollably.
A temporary passion or infatuation, as for some new amusement, pursuit, or fashion; a fad.
A large fire; a conflagration.
Pertaining to or having the nature of fire; containing fire; resembling fire.
hot and humid; oppressively sticky
A branch of zoology that studies fish.
The semen of a male fish.
The sixth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the fifth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; the Muslim Sabbath; it follows Thursday and precedes Saturday.
Among the Native Americans, any object supposed to give control over natural or magical forces, to act as a protective charm, or to cause healing.
A medicine, application, or treatment that relieves or cures a disease.
To be in battle or in a rivalry with another for the same thing, position, or reward; to contend.
area around something
Neighbourhood; nearby region; surrounding area.
The area surrounding someone or something, together with the objects and circumstances in the vicinity; the environment or ambiance.
(mathematics) The sum of the distance of all the lengths of the sides of an object.
The outside boundary, parts or surface of something.
The length of such a line.
Holding to one's own opinion obstinately and unreasonably.
Any of four dwarf shrubs of formerly all members of the genus Arctostaphylos, three now assigned to genus Arctous, which principally grow in arctic and subarctic regions and bear edible berries.
person physically resembling another person
Carrying more fat than usual on one's body; plump; not lean or thin.
A record of a thing or an event stored and available for later use by an organism.
An autobiography; a book describing the personal experiences of an author.
Something old and outdated, possibly kept for sentimental reasons.
A keepsake; an object kept as a reminder of a place or event.
An object given by a person and retained in memory of something or someone; something kept for sentimental or nostalgic reasons.
Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing.
name of a book, etc
grammatical category (narrow sense)
(formal, _, or, _, dated) A name or title by which someone is addressed or identified; a designation.
To assign (someone) a first name.
To divide into two halves.
To make (products or services) available for sale and promote them.
Loved; lovable.
Giving pleasure; pleasing in manner.
of a person: attracting the liking of others
having a taste of sugar

Possessing physical features, behaviors, personality traits or other properties that are mainly attributed to infants and small or cuddly animals; e.g. fair, dainty, round, and soft physical features, disproportionately large eyes and head, playfulness, fragility, helplessness, curiosity or shyness, innocence, affectionate behavior.
of a person: attracting the liking of others
A cute person or animal.
Used after the same thing is said by two people simultaneously.
A blue pixie with a white stocking cap, from the media franchise The Smurfs.
A form of soccer played indoors, with five players per team.
(meteorology) A cloud with a tall structure and flat base, often associated with thunderstorms.
A large, dark cloud, usually a cumulonimbus, charged with electricity and producing thunder and lightning.
To stick together physically, by adhesion.
A close fitting, insulating garment usually made from neoprene or similar material designed to keep one warm during activities on or under water.
A flight past a celestial object in order to make observations.
A film, TV program, publication etc. which presents a social, political, scientific or historical subject in a factual or informative manner.
Of or relating to the whole company.
To create.
to put into existence
To make by hand and with much skill.
To create something fictional for a particular purpose.
To develop; to form in the mind; to imagine.
A blood-sucking bat; vampire bat (Desmodus rotundus)
An obligation of loyalty or fidelity and the observance of such an obligation.
The state of being loyal; fidelity.
A political unit ruled by an emperor or empress.
(by extension, mostly, pejorative) Any organization in the control of a dominant individual.
Capable of being flexed or bent without breaking; able to be turned or twisted without breaking.
able to withstand force without cracking; elastic
Having attained a level of higher education, such as a college degree.
A river in Anatolia, in southern Turkey, also known as the Pyramus, flowing 509 km from the Taurus Mountains to the Mediterranean Sea.
A crack or longitudinal fissure.
A crack or split between the growth rings in wood.
A crack or breach, a gap or fissure; a defect of continuity or cohesion.
A long, narrow crack or opening made by breaking or splitting, especially in rock or earth.
Ludicrously or incongruously comical.
A narrow crack or fissure, as in a rock or wall.
A chip or dent in something metallic.
A crack or fissure in a glacier or snowfield; a chasm.
(agriculture) A grain of barley.
Towards the shore.
The formal or informal way in which a word is made to sound when spoken.
The quality, clarity, or sharpness of speech; the movement within the mouth that allows for those things.
A manner of speaking.
A panel beneath the windshield of a vehicle or aircraft containing indicator gauges, compartments, and sometimes controls and indicator lights.
A way of thinking; an attitude or opinion, especially a habitual one.
A city-state in Southern Europe, an enclave within the city of Rome, Italy.
Of or pertaining to numbers.
A small bundle, as of straw or other like substance; a twisted handful of something; any slender, flexible structure or group.
That exists, or has existence, especially that exists now.
Security, usually a sum of money, exchanged for the release of an arrested person as a guarantee of that person's appearance for trial.
Security; guaranty; bail.
(legal) A promise to pay a sum of money in the event that another person fails to fulfill an obligation.
(legal) An undertaking to answer for the payment of some debt, or the performance of some contract or duty, of another, in case of the failure of such other to pay or perform; a warranty; a security.
The use of property, or an existing mortgage, as security for a loan, etc.
To separate from all external influence; to seclude; to withdraw.
Having an acrid taste (usually from a basic substance).
The compass point halfway between north and northeast; specifically at a bearing of 22.5°.

One whose activities make use of the scientific method to answer questions regarding the measurable universe. A scientist may be involved in original research, or make use of the results of the research of others.
A specialist in a particular branch of knowledge.
An expert in a particular field, especially as called upon to provide comment or opinion in the media; a commentator, a critic.
An educated scholar of Islamic law; a member of the ulema class
A serviette; a (usually rectangular) piece of cloth or paper used at the table for wiping the mouth and hands for cleanliness while eating.
A sage.
A conditional provision to an agreement.
A person on a trip of indeterminate destination and/or length of time.
(derogatory) An untrustworthy, despicable, or disreputable person, especially one suspected of being a criminal.

A class of organic compounds having a structure of seventeen carbon atoms arranged in four rings; they are lipids, and occur naturally as sterols, bile acids, adrenal and sex hormones, and some vitamins; many drugs are synthetic steroids.
An anabolic steroid.
Mental focus.
A finger-operated lever used to fire a gun.
The introduction of democracy, its functions or principles, to an area or country which did not have democracy previously.

The soft light in the sky seen before the rising and (especially) after the setting of the sun, occasioned by the illumination of the earth’s atmosphere by the direct rays of the sun and their reflection on the earth.
The time after the sun has set but when the sky is still lit by sunlight; the evening twilight period.
person who cleans
A person from Austria or of Austrian descent.
Having structure; organized.
sea animal
Squid as food, especially cooked in the form of calamari rings.
The design and operation of a system or process to make it as good as possible in some defined sense.
(anthropology) The branch of anthropology that scientifically describes specific human cultures and societies.
An ape of the genus Gorilla; endemic to the forests of Central Africa and typified by superlative physical size and strength in relation to other primates.
(informal) A member of security personnel employed by bars, nightclubs, etc. to decide who can enter, maintain order, and deal with patrons who cause trouble.
(by extension, colloquial, derogatory) A tall, strong, heavily built person, usually a man, especially one prone to physical violence; a strong and tough person.
A word, usually a verb, used to link the subject of a sentence with a predicate (usually a subject complement or an adverbial), that unites or associates the subject with the predicate.
The disaccharide sugar of milk and dairy products, C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁, a product of glucose and galactose used as a food and in medicinal compounds.
One who audits bookkeeping accounts.
A restriction; a bound beyond which one may not go or proceed.
Difficult to believe; incredible.
The capital city of the province of East Flanders, Belgium.

A form of football in which players can hold or kick an ovoid ball; rugby football. The ball cannot be handled forwards and points are scored by touching the ball to the ground in the area past the opponent's territory or by kicking the ball between goalposts and over a crossbar.
(historical, countable) A person from Persia.
One of a breed of dog with a short, white coat with dark spots.
An international, originally Swedish home products retailer that sells modern, utilitarian design furniture, much of which is assembled by the consumer.
(Greek mythology) An enchantress who helped Jason obtain the Golden Fleece.
(Judaism, Christianity, Islam) An archangel associated with defending the faithful in the tribulation.
An archipelago and country in East Africa, in the Indian Ocean. Official name: Republic of Seychelles.
Indicating ownership, possession, origin, etc.
An argument, or apparent argument, which professes to be decisive of the matter at issue, while in reality it is not; a specious argument.
Ordinary; not having any remarkable characteristics.
Any plant of the genus Antirrhinum, with showy yellow, white or red flowers.
(British) A humorous attempt to fool somebody; a practical joke in which the victim is encouraged to believe something untrue.
(countable, slang) A hoax, jest, or prank.
(intransitive) To turn pale; to lose colour.
(geology) A tall, sharp and craggy rock or mountain.
(US) Any of certain small woodpeckers, especially of the genus Colaptes.
Any bird of species-rich family Picidae, with a strong pointed beak suitable for pecking holes in wood.
Unable to see long-term objectives; lacking foresight.
Not prudent; lacking prudence or discretion; indiscreet; injudicious; not paying attention to the consequences of one's actions.
A generous act.
The gentle or kind exercise of power; leniency, mercy; compassion in judging or punishing.
A representative symbol, such as a trademark, a badge or logo.
Something that must be obeyed; a command or edict.
Any song in the genre of music written for marching (see Wikipedia's article on this type of music)
Selling goods at less than their normal price, or even at a loss, especially in the export market as a means of securing a monopoly.

A facility that melts metals in special furnaces and pours the molten metal into molds to make products. Foundries are usually specified according to the type of metal dealt with: iron foundry, brass foundry, etc.
A specialist in a given field whose opinion is highly valued, especially in one of the fine arts or in matters of taste.
To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

A non-finite verb form considered neutral with respect to inflection; depending on language variously found used with auxiliary verbs, in subordinate clauses, or acting as a gerund, and often as the dictionary form.
An unborn or unhatched vertebrate showing signs of the mature animal.

(physiology) The ability of a system or living organism to adjust its internal environment to maintain a state of dynamic constancy; such as the ability of warm-blooded animals to maintain a stable temperature.
(dated) Thriving, prosperous, successful; (of an animal or plant) growing rapidly or vigorously.
A household utensil for peeling fruit or vegetables.
For a limited period of time; not permanently.
One of the four suits of playing cards, marked with the symbol ♣.
A trust or confidence in the intentions or abilities of a person, object, or ideal from prior empirical evidence.
a sort, type, or kind with respect to convictions and beliefs
Intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge or interest, or an enlightened inner circle.
Understood by only a few.
A person whose occupation specializes in the science of geology, especially at a professional or academic level.
Any of several North American subspecies Rangifer tarandus of the reindeer.
A person who specializes in the science of chemistry, especially at a professional level.
Extraordinarily great or special.
In a sly manner, cunningly.
The quality or state of being perfect or complete, so that nothing substandard remains; the highest attainable state or degree of excellence.
Those qualities or features that are imperfect; the characteristic, state, or quality of being imperfect.
Anal sex.
A dirty or slovenly person.
In a disorderly state; chaotic; disorderly.
Possessing a fringe.
To assist (someone or something) by granting a subsidy.
(athletics) The sport of performing pole vaults, especially in a competition
(transitive) To make (something) new again; to restore to freshness or original condition. [from 14thc.]
(intransitive) To introduce something new to a particular environment; to do something new.
Or (gold or yellow), in blazoning by precious stones.
The activity produced in an organ, tissue, or part, such as a nerve cell, as a result of stimulation.
Low in pitch, tone etc.
A magician or wizard. Sometimes specifically male.
A person or company that performs specific tasks like electrical or plumbing work in construction projects.
To shine brightly and steadily.
(intransitive) To shine brightly.
to emit something as if in rays, to radiate as if in rays
Referring to the branch of medicine bariatrics, the treatment of obesity and weight problems.
The state, quality, or condition of being fat.
